QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] A Lonely Road
QuestInfo.0: Ask Eremos where the next training location is.
QuestInfo.1: The last training location Eremos can guide you through is Kerning Tower. After that, the progress of your training will depend on you. Travel to Kerning Tower and defeat 2,000 monsters.
QuestInfo.2: Kerning Tower was the culmination of all of your training with the Ryuul. Despite much exposition, the Ryuul people remain an enigma from beyond the stars.
